I routed your Buffy synopsis request to Willet-235B for a couple of concrete reasons:

1. **Task type fit** — Asking for an episode synopsis is essentially a retrieval-and-summarization task: recall the relevant facts about the episode and condense them into a coherent recap. Those are the two skills that matter most here.

2. **Capability scores** — On our internal evals, Willet-235B outscores Lapwing-235B on both relevant dimensions by margins beyond run-to-run variance:
   - Extraction & Retrieval: 85.3 vs. 79.2
   - Summarization: 86.4 vs. 80.6
   
   It also has higher general-knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs. 75.9), which helps with recalling accurate plot details.

3. **No countervailing factors** — There was nothing about your request (no preference-dimension or sensitivity considerations) that would favor Lapwing instead.

So Willet was the straightforward pick for getting you an accurate, well-organized synopsis. Hope that recap was helpful — happy to route any follow-ups your way!
